aliases: Thai Digital Assets Exchange Co., Ltd.
entity.summary: Thai centralized digital-asset exchange operated by a Stock Exchange of Thailand subsidiary, focused on trading and settlement of digital tokens.
entity.notes: Current Stock Exchange of Thailand pages identify Thai Digital Assets Exchange Co., Ltd. as a SET subsidiary operating a Digital Asset Exchange for trading and exchanging digital assets, with current account-opening, trading, token information, and fee surfaces. The current Thailand SEC license-check page lists TDX under Digital Asset Exchange. The official history states the company was established on 2020-09-14 and licensed on 2022-03-25; HEI does not convert either date into an inferred exact exchange launch date.
